name: Schwann cell
short_description: Myelin-making glial cell of the peripheral nervous system: a single Schwann cell spirally wraps its own plasma membrane around one segment (internode) of one axon, with its flattened nucleus pressed into the outer myelin it built. Also drives peripheral nerve regeneration after injury by clearing debris and guiding regrowing axons.
